## Field.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `label` :: The label text. It is a real `<label>` bound to the control, and doubles as the accessible name of grouped controls.
- `hint` :: Helper text shown under the control and read after its name. Replaced by `error` while there is one.
- `error` :: An error message. Marks the control invalid and is announced politely when it appears.
- `required` :: Marks the control required and adds a marker beside the label.
- `disabled` :: Disables the control inside and dims the label.
- `orientation` :: Whether the label sits above the control or to its side.
- `gap` :: Spacing between the label and the control, and between the control and its hint. Defaults to `gap-lg` horizontally and `gap-xs` vertically.
- `size` :: The control height and text scale, inherited by the control inside unless it sets its own.
- `shape` :: The corner shape, inherited by the control inside unless it sets its own.
- `variant` :: The surface, inherited by the control inside unless it sets its own. `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one, `ghost` bare until hovered.
- `textSize` :: The label's text scale.
- `textColor` :: The label's text colour.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the hint and the error under the control; follows `textSize` when omitted.
- `childTextColor` :: The colour of the hint and the error. Left unset it keeps the semantic pair: muted hint, danger error.
- `measure` :: The width of the label column in the horizontal layout, so long labels can line up; ignored when the label sits above the control.
- `id` :: The id given to the control inside. Generated when omitted.
- `children` :: The control. Inputs in this kit pick up the id, description and invalid state automatically.

## field.ts

### `interface FieldContext`

What a `Field` shares with the control inside it. Every member is reactive.

- `controlId` :: The id the control should carry — the label's `for` points at it.
- `labelId` :: The id of the label element, for controls that are groups (`aria-labelledby`).
- `describedBy` :: The ids of the hint or error text, for `aria-describedby`.
- `invalid` :: Whether the field has an error.
- `required` :: Whether the field is required.
- `disabled` :: Whether the field is disabled.
- `size` :: The control height, inherited when the control does not set its own.
- `shape` :: The corner shape, inherited when the control does not set its own.
- `variant` :: The surface, inherited when the control does not set its own.

### `function setFieldContext`

Provide a field context to descendants. Called by `Field`.

### `function getFieldContext`

The nearest `Field`'s context, or `undefined` outside one. Call it during component initialisation.

### `interface FieldControlOwn`

A control's own settings, which win over the field's.

### `interface FieldControl`

The merged attributes a control puts on its native element.

- `inField` :: Whether a `Field` is wrapping the control.
- `size` :: Own size, else the field's, else `undefined` (the control applies its default).
- `shape` :: Own shape, else the field's, else `undefined`.
- `variant` :: Own variant, else the field's, else `undefined`.

### `function useFieldControl`

Merge a control's own props with the surrounding `Field`: the control's value wins; otherwise the field's applies. Call it during component initialisation. @param fallbackId An id for the control when neither it nor a field supplies one (`$props.id()`). @param own A getter for the control's own props, so the result stays reactive.
